subject: [hw] DONE V41 rev 5: AP encoder + DMA mirror; 630/630; plain-tree H.264 validated 115841 B
body:
DONE V41 rev 5 (host-tested only; no phone, nothing published, no commit outside ap/** + dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md).

  bash gpu/hwcodec/ap/test_v41/run_tests.sh
  -> N2TEST V41 PASS 630/630
    (591 checks in each of ASan+UBSan -O1, plain -O2 and TSan -O1; 39 real-n2vcu checks x2;
     63 layout lines vs the kernel's own header; armv7 static asserts; arm64-ios16 compile)

Rev 5 is root's restart item plus opus-venc's two protocol findings:
1. usleep -> nanosleep (IP's host-library -Werror failure).
2. n2ap_venc_power(e,on), refcounted and shared with POWER_ON/OFF; only RWVC_BLK_VENC for core 0 (hw-k02: VENC_C1 is the whole core-1 power domain).
3. Every successful encode drains venc_vsi.list_free before the result lookup (the kernel's sync-mode mtk_enc_put_buf). Required for the sequence header, which libvpud_vcodec answers with ENCODE_ACK and only a list_free size.
4. FRAME_FINAL without a frame is the EOS flush; only FRAME needs one.
5. wait_done uses CLOCK_MONOTONIC and syncs the bitstream from_device after the async result.
6. IV's carry patches (encode_fd, wait_done, ap_owned unmap) are now owned code with tests; new fake-daemon modes pin async ACK + late PUT_BUFFER, the timeout, the seq-hdr ring-only result, the fd fields, power refcounts and VENC_C1 staying 0.

Integration evidence on the plain tree (host only, vendor files read at run time):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/fakevenc/run_session.sh -> "encode seq-hdr bytes=29", "encode frame fds=1 bytes=115812 key=1", 115841-byte H.264 validated (SPS/geometry/decode/PSNR)
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/run_vhost.sh -> reached M-f, same 115841-byte stream validated
  bash gpu/hwcodec/host/test_iv/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST IV PASS 72/72
  make -C gpu/hwcodec/host lib OUT=/tmp/n2hw-test-ip2 -j2 -> 34/34 objects, san and o2, 0 failed

Files: ap/n2ap_venc.c, ap/n2ap_venc.h, ap/n2vc_dma.c, ap/test_v41/t_v41.c, ap/MESSAGE_FLOW.md (+ mtk_venc_ipi.h unchanged this rev), dsh-state/workers/V41/STATUS.md.

Not done (full list in STATUS): no phone run and not in build_ios.sh's object list; single-plane source; no timestamp/ROI/QP/HDR metadata; one job at a time and one session per IPI id; no guest address reclaim; no bitstream plausibility check in the AP; the M-d vcu_inst_addr question remains a V34/V40 matter. Review by hw-r1/hw-r2 requested; staying available for findings.
